title: TOEIC Listening & Reading Full Test 08
description: Đề thi đầy đủ theo cấu trúc đề TOEIC Listening & Reading của IIG Việt Nam: 200 câu, 120 phút (Listening ~45 phút audio chạy liên tục, Reading 75 phút). Chủ đề: tiệm giặt khô, ứng dụng đỗ xe, nhà hát, thuê xe, kho thực phẩm, đường sắt nhẹ, trường học dùng điện mặt trời, nội thất gỗ tái chế, hoà nhạc mùa hè, khoá học ngoại ngữ; đủ dạng hội thoại 3 người, câu hỏi hàm ý, biểu đồ, chèn câu, đoạn kép và ba đoạn. Mỗi câu có giải thích tiếng Việt.

Timber & Grain Finds Success with Reclaimed Wood

PORTLAND (August 20) – When Daniel and Sophie Marsh opened Timber & Grain in a small garage eight years ago, they built tables from wood collected from old barns and warehouses. Today, the company employs 35 people and sells its furniture in 14 states.

The Marshes say their customers appreciate knowing the history of each piece. Every item comes with a card that describes where its wood came from, such as a 100-year-old farmhouse or a closed factory. "People want furniture with a story," said Sophie Marsh.

The company's products are not cheap. A dining table typically costs between $2,000 and $4,000. However, demand has been so strong that customers often wait up to ten weeks for their orders.

To keep up with orders, Timber & Grain will move into a larger workshop in October. The new facility will triple the company's production capacity and include a showroom where customers can see finished pieces and watch the craftspeople at work.
